generation_history.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a production 3D reconstruction turnaround sheet of ONE loose bundle of THREE rolled navigation charts for Captain LivÃ©'s pirate cabin. Input image is a STYLE AND MATERIAL reference only: warm ivory worn parchment, chunky sculpted cartoon adventure-game forms matching the room; do not include the room, characters, desk or any other object.

Single horizontal row of four complete views, FRONT / LEFT / RIGHT / BACK in exactly that order, on pure flat white, no labels. True orthographic cameras on the four cardinal axes, perfectly LEVEL at bundle midheight, ZERO pitch, zero perspective. Important: the OBJECT itself has a fixed diagonal reconstruction orientation, with the horizontal roll axes yawed 45 degrees in the XZ ground plane. This is NOT a tilted or perspective camera. The exact same object stays fixed in all four views; rotate only the cardinal viewing direction by 90 degrees. Thus each orthographic elevation shows long cylindrical bodies AND readable elliptical rolled ends, and all four have equal overall height and comparable width at one shared scale. Front shows the near ends on the right, left view near ends on the left, right view near ends on the right, back near ends on the left; opposite views reverse the same geometry.

Geometry: THREE parallel equally long cylindrical paper rolls, 600 mm long and 40 mm diameter, tightly touching in triangular cross-section: two lower cylinders side by side, one upper cylinder nested in the valley. Bundle height 74.64 mm, depth across cylinders 80 mm, length600mm. All roll ends lie in the same plane at each end. Thick visible rolled-paper spiral edges, dark recessed hollow cores, clearly separated round tube volumes. Show THREE exposed end faces in every view; their circular faces project into ellipses with width about0.707 times their vertical diameter, consistent with fixed45degree yaw. No wooden handles, metal rods, ties, ribbon or fastenings. The upper roll and lower visible rolls have rounded convex cross-sections, broad gentle shading wrapping around their bodies, strong readable longitudinal valleys, not a stack of flat paper slabs. Slight irregular parchment grain and a few broad creases, no torn projecting flaps, no legible map writing. Warm cream paper and restrained honey-brown edge wear. No dramatic key light, no cast shadow or ground plane.

Framing: wide landscape sheet, all FOUR silhouettes about the SAME width and EXACTLY the same height and common baseline, each bundle about6.44 times wider than high. Fit large within their four cells without clipping. Keep substantial clean white separators. The ends must be crisply readable as layered paper spirals with actual recessed cores. No separately magnified end detail panels, no alternate scale, no lens perspective, no elevated camera, no top-view tilt. Neutral white background throughout. Four coherent orthographic views of one fixed diagonal object, not four perspective poses.

dimension_contract.authority: Retain previous engine resting-orientation bounding target 0.60 × 0.08 × 0.08 m; long axis X.
dimension_contract.rule: Undo reconstruction yaw first, then measure bounds and fit dimensions. Never stretch individual image views.
dimension_contract.guide_note: Three equal cylinders in triangle replace former four-roll square. Guide height is inside retained nominal 0.08m envelope; fitting and topology require engine verification.

design.arrangement: Two parallel rolls below, one above, touching in triangular cross-section; all equally long, loose and untied.
design.materials: Warm ivory parchment, broad tan painted areas, dark brown contours and simple faceted form shading. No realistic paper noise.
design.ends: Three layered rolled-paper rims with recessed dark hollow cores visible in every elevation.

framing.projection: Level cardinal orthographic elevations of a fixed diagonally yawed object
framing.reconstruction_orientation: Horizontal roll axis along (1,0,-1), 45 degrees from +X toward -Z; vertical axis +Y. Camera pitch/roll zero.
framing.resting_orientation_correction: Rotate horizontal axis from (1,0,-1) back to +X, equivalent to -45 degree Y rotation in right-handed convention. Check actual mesh axis before applying.
framing.background: Flat opaque near-white, no labels, scenery or cast shadows.
framing.scale: Single scale across all views; height spread1px; no independent resizing.

assembly.method: Unchanged cutter translated own-bounds native source crops into four605px cells using --size605; no resampling or repainting.
assembly.command: python tools/crop_views.py <generated_source> --row 0 1 --names front left right back --size 605 --dry-run --preview art/props/rolled_charts/sheet.png

validation.method: Visual comparison to lantern/globe/candle/captain, complete PNG decoding, cutter detection, RGB distance from253 greater than54 foreground measurements.
